focal_entities.audience: the user at the goal sign-off, approving what the finished work will do and why, and rn's orchestrator in any later conversation, carrying the work on without asking them again

goal_orientation.purpose: approving the goal and the acceptance criteria, then carrying each later work to them

constraints.decision: Purpose: Files directly under the Downloads folder are scattered and hard to find; the tool sorts them into folders by kind (images, documents, archives and so on) so they are easy to find. It never deletes anything.

Acceptance criteria: The finished tool is done when:
- Run with nothing added, it only shows which file it would move where, and moves nothing. It moves files only when told to move them.
- Told to move, it moves each file directly under Downloads into the folder of its kind (images, documents, archives and so on); a file of no known kind goes to a folder for those.
- It only moves: it never deletes, renames or overwrites anything. Where a file of the same name is already at the destination, that file stays where it was and is reported.
- It leaves the contents of subfolders untouched.
- It works on macOS and Linux.
- The README says how to install it and how to use it, and tests check each behaviour above.

UX document: A UX document, kind ux, is made at .rn/20261030-tidy-downloads-cli/ux.md in the session's folder alone, outside what the work leaves in the repository, so how the tool is used is settled and approved before it is built.
README: The existing README.md, kind readme, is rewritten as this tool's README, so whoever opens the repository reads about the tool first; its two playground lines go.
